ownerDecision.request: make this tank too ... a russian tank of a giant missile battery ... launches missiles super quickly ... based on the hull t90ms tagil
ownerDecision.scope: Retain the playable T-90MS Tagil chassis and build a new TOS-1A-photo-inspired 24-tube launcher with rapid unguided rocket gameplay.

tos1a_tagil.silhouette: A broad three-by-eight circular-tube battery with a chamfered armored housing and heavy pitching cradle above the retained T-90MS Tagil chassis

requiredProof: Physical HIGH/LOW24 tubes with finite mouth rims, sleeve walls, rear stock and clear aim axes
Preserved original Tagil hull/gear, permanent armor after ERA depletion, canonical chassis motion
Seated yaw/pitch cradles and legal poses; missing/blocked/detached mutation negatives
Independent14-view native photo/concept review; no fabricated source-fidelity score
24-shot local and authoritative firing, finite ammunition, full rack reload, successive launch origins, no homing or cannon recoil
Complete unchanged physical gates, anatomy, asset/centering, full tests, typecheck and public/private builds
status: Frozen design contract, not a qualification receipt.
